<!--
  Before you spend real effort, please read CONTRIBUTING.md.

  Short version: this repo is published from a private working repo through an explicit
  allowlist, so PRs are never merged with the merge button (anything merged here is
  overwritten at the next publish). Instead the change is ported by hand, you are credited
  in the CHANGELOG and added as a co-author on the published commit, and the PR is closed
  with a link to the release carrying your work.

  It is more friction than a normal merge, so it is better that you know now than after you
  have written the patch. An issue with a clear diagnosis is just as valuable here and costs
  you far less.
-->
